content: Target repositories for review: vox (/Users/cwilson/workspace/black-meridian/styrene-lab/vox) and nex (/Users/cwilson/workspace/black-meridian/styrene-lab/nex). Both are Rust codebases.

vox is a unified communication extension framework for omegon agents. Workspace crates: vox-core (traits/types), vox (main binary), vox-slack, vox-discord, vox-voice, vox-lxmf, vox-signal, vox-email. Written in Rust.

nex is a CLI package manager providing imperative UX on top of nix-darwin + Homebrew. Key modules: resolve.rs (multi-source package resolution), edit.rs (nix file editing with backup/restore), exec.rs (subprocess management), ops/ (subcommands). Written in Rust.
Both repos use conventional commits, cargo clippy, rustfmt, and have CI pipelines. Check Cargo.toml for workspace structure.
vox_send requires: channel="discord", envelope={kind:"channel", workspace:"1113581684231778366", channel_id:"<id>"}, body=[{type:"text", content:"<msg>"}]. Keep messages under 2000 characters.
This agent runs as a oneshot — it does its work and exits. It does not stay running as a daemon.
